verdict.rationale: Snowflake Notebooks (Snowsight) is documented as a first-party, cell-based environment supporting SQL, Python, and Markdown, with inline cell-by-cell execution and result comparison, and support for data science/ML workflows directly against warehouse data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of inline chart/visualization rendering within notebooks (charting is only demonstrated for the broader Snowsight UI, not confirmed inline in notebooks) and independent hands-on user corroboration.
